- Confirm the evaluation success criteria in tab "Eval KPIs" (we highlighted latency and 95th pct stable throughput).
- Confirm procurement path and whether you need a Redwood PO or standard vendor invoice.
- Can we lock a final go/no-go decision window the week of Apr 12? That gives us time to get paperwork and legal sign-off if the eval results look good.

Proposed signature cadence if you approve:
- DocuSign envelope sent Apr 14 morning (PT)
- Signer window Apr 14 09:00–17:00 PT to accommodate US and EMEA stakeholders
- Target activation / first provisioning Apr 26 (two-week ops lead time from signature)

Attachments: MAP_v4.xlsx (working copy), SOW_draft_v5.pdf, pricing_summary_0427.xlsx (high-level).

If that timeline looks tight on your side, tell me the latest date your exec can sign and we’ll compress the ops tasks.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Cheers,

- Eval KPIs: the latency target is fine; can you add a short test plan for the 95th percentile traffic spike? Our infra team will run it during week 3.
- Procurement: we usually issue a PO after contract signature. Can you accept a PO within 5 business days of DocuSign completion?
- Exec availability: our VP Ops can sign on Apr 14 but prefers late morning PT. Would that still work?

Two asks: add a one-page acceptance checklist into the SOW (to make internal approvals smoother) and can you confirm whether we can get a small 10% startup credit applied to the first month if we hit eval goals?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Erin Sullivan
